title: Anytime-Valid Runtime Monitoring of Learned Barrier Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2610.27726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned barrier certificates provide a principled mechanism for establishing safety of stochastic systems, but their validity may deteriorate during deployment when the underlying dynamics differ from those used for training. We propose an anytime-valid runtime monitor that audits a learned barrier certificate using observed closed-loop trajectories. The monitor is intended to detect loss of statistical support for the deployed barrier condition; it does not by itself guarantee detection before unsafe entry or safety of a subsequent intervention. Specifically, the conditional barrier-drift condition is formulated as an episode-wise sequential hypothesis test, and observed barrier increments are transformed into a nonnegative test supermartingale, yielding finite-sample false-alarm control under arbitrary stopping times. translated_title: 学习型屏障证书的任意时刻有效运行时监控
translated_abstract: 学习到的屏障证书为随机系统的安全性验证提供了一种原则性机制，但当部署时的底层动力学与训练时所用的动力学不同，其有效性可能在部署过程中逐渐退化。我们提出了一种任意时刻有效的运行时监控器，利用观测到的闭环轨迹对学习到的屏障证书进行审计。该监控器旨在检测已部署的屏障条件失去统计支持的情况；其本身并不保证能在进入不安全状态之前完成检测，也不保证后续干预措施的安全性。具体而言，我们将条件屏障漂移条件表述为按回合进行的序贯假设检验，并将观测到的屏障增量转换为非负的检验上鞅，从而在任意停止时间下实现有限样本的误报控制。受有限时域安全性验证的启发，我们进一步对监控统计量引入了确定性的时间整形方法……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种任意时刻有效的运行时监控框架，通过将屏障漂移条件转化为基于非负检验上鞅的按回合序贯假设检验，利用观测到的闭环轨迹在线审计学习型屏障证书的统计有效性，并在任意停止时间下实现有限样本误报控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an anytime-valid runtime monitoring framework that audits learned barrier certificates using observed closed-loop trajectories, by formulating the conditional barrier-drift condition as an episode-wise sequential hypothesis test with nonnegative test supermartingales, achieving finite-sample false-alarm control under arbitrary stopping times.
